name: adv_userdef_named_output
source:
// A user-defined component: named outputs are reachable as INST.Local, its
// locals are per-instance mangled, and its ports infer a domain from members.
COMPONENT Divider(in, out)
  PARAM k
  out.mdot = in.mdot / k
  out.P    = in.P
  out.h    = in.h
  leak     = in.mdot - out.mdot
END
COMPONENT FluidBoundary(out)
  PARAM P, h, mdot
  out.P    = P
  out.h    = h
  out.mdot = mdot
END
FluidBoundary SRC(f1, P = 200000, h = 154000, mdot = 4.0)
Divider       D1(f1, f2, k = 2)
Divider       D2(f2, f3, k = 4)
Sink          SK(f3)
l1 = D1.leak
l2 = D2.leak
m3 = f3.mdot
